- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (soft)

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts outside personality scope
- AI use without disclosure per Elsevier policy
- Pure single-cross-sectional without theoretical contribution

### Soft Tax

Low for personality-tradition empirical authors. 24-month AAM embargo on subscription path.

### Best Suited For

- Personality process research (situational, longitudinal)
- Big Five / HEXACO empirical work
- Personality measurement studies
- Dark personality empirical research
- Person-environment dynamics
- Personality meta-analyses

### Not Recommended For

- Pure social psychology without personality angle
- Applied I/O personality (consider Personnel Psych)
- Pure qualitative

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Personality](./journal-of-personality.md) | Wiley peer; personality flagship |
| 2 | [Personality and Individual Differences](./personality-and-individual-differences.md) | Elsevier peer; broader individual-differences |
| 3 | [European Journal of Personality](./european-journal-of-personality.md) | EAPP peer; European personality community |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from J Personality as "more process-than-structure," JRP is the Elsevier home for personality process / situational research.
